strokeOrder: draw the upper-left horizontal from left to right
lift and descend through the crossing left-falling stem
lift and draw the short upper-right diagonal down and right
lift, descend through the lower-right stem, turn around the loop, and sweep right to the finish
strokeOrderNote: Sirgazil's 32-frame animation writes な in four separate pen-down runs: horizontal, crossing left-falling stem, upper-right diagonal, then the lower-right stem, loop, and outward sweep.

strokeOrderSource.citation: Sirgazil, Hiragana な stroke order animation.gif, hiragana な, 32 frames, 3.2 seconds (Wikimedia Commons, 1 October 2009)
strokeOrderSource.variation: The CC0 animation draws な in four pen-down runs with three lifts: the upper-left horizontal, crossing left-falling stem, short upper-right diagonal, then the lower-right stem continuing around the loop and out to the right. The learner path is fitted to the bundled Noto Sans JP subset; handwritten diagonal angle and loop size vary, but the four-run order remains the same.

notes: The na of なまえ; one mora, pronounced as a short, even beat.
